name: What accessibility modifications are common for bathrooms?

mainEntity.name: What accessibility modifications are common for bathrooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common bathroom accessibility modifications include installing grab bars near toilets and in showers, converting to a roll-in or curbless shower, raising toilet heights, and adding adjustable-height showerheads. Other popular changes involve widening doorways, installing lever-style faucet handles, and ensuring clear floor space for wheelchair maneuverability under sinks. These changes enhance safety and ease of use.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common bathroom modifications include grab bars, roll-in showers, raised toilets, and wider doorways to improve safety and access.
